crossBatchIdentityReconciliation.technicalFinding: In src/resolve.ts (lines 112-119), resolveAirport() returns status='resolved' only when result.candidates.every(c => c.airport.airportId === first.airport.airportId). Because global-code-expansion/global-code-next assigned apt_eb176a20-e0e3-438d-a330-a7b81185232d to OurAirports 3766 while global-public-data generated apt_f12cc00a-7d95-478e-bc87-a67c836379a3 for the same physical airport, admitting both without reconciliation would cause validateDataset() to fail on duplicate OurAirports identity 3766 and would downgrade all 26 resolved KDJT days (2026-10-02..2026-10-27) to 'uncertain'. Reconciling onto apt_eb176a20-e0e3-438d-a330-a7b81185232d eliminates the duplicate physical airport and preserves all 26 resolved KDJT days.
